titre: Électricité propre contractée par les entreprises américaines
sous_titre: GW annoncés par année, 2023 à 2025 et premier trimestre 2026

2023.texte: Since 2014, CEBA has tracked over 143.8 GW of clean energy deals in the U.S.

2024.texte: Notably, 2025 marked the second consecutive record year for announced capacity in the U.S.

2025.texte: In 2025 alone, CEBA tracked over 27 GW of announced capacity

2026 T1.texte: early momentum has continued into 2026, with more than 13 GW announced in the first quarter
